hosting.en: Cloudflare Workers, static assets from site/, with the Go engine compiled to WebAssembly for the playground
hosting.pt: Cloudflare Workers, assets estáticos de site/, com o motor em Go compilado para WebAssembly no playground

what.en: Builds the playground engine into public/assets: engine.wasm and the Go toolchain's wasm_exec.js
what.pt: Monta o motor do playground em public/assets: engine.wasm e o wasm_exec.js do Go

breaks.en: The playground loads no engine, or one out of step with the CLI
breaks.pt: O playground não carrega motor, ou um fora de passo com a CLI

what.en: Uploads the landing page and playground
what.pt: Sobe a página e o playground

breaks.en: The live page keeps its last deploy
breaks.pt: A página no ar segue no último deploy

what.en: Tests and vets every push and pull request
what.pt: Testa e confere cada push e pull request

breaks.en: A broken CLI can merge unnoticed
breaks.pt: Uma CLI quebrada pode entrar sem ninguém ver

what.en: Builds and publishes the release binaries on a tag
what.pt: Monta e publica os binários numa tag

breaks.en: No downloadable release for a new version

what.en: Writes the shared footer (support block, QR codes, four columns) in English and pt-BR
what.pt: Escreve o rodapé comum (apoio, QR codes, quatro colunas) em inglês e pt-BR

breaks.en: Footers drift apart between the family sites
breaks.pt: Os rodapés divergem entre os sites da família
